natural_client_initiation.scope: Canonical initial business request occurred once in the actual coordinator native thread; the 13-input retrospective audit distinguishes natural business inputs from three host setup envelopes.

tool_or_role_execution.scope: Three distinct Codex native threads performed coordinator/content, peer/venue and successor/venue work. Public evidence binds actual authorship, AWR sessions/claims/branches, RevisionConflict and later ClaimConflict without equating runtime branches to isolated Git worktrees.

real_artifact.scope: The final sealed snapshot contains eight hash-bound business/review/delivery artifacts with authorship attributed to actual producing turns rather than shared snapshot membership.

business_followup_1.scope: The first canonical followup introduced the temporary absence, was sent once to the actual coordinator, and led to a separately executed successor handoff that preserved unresolved venue matters.

business_followup_2.scope: The second canonical followup requested separate result checks and common actions; the coordinator then corrected the stale handoff wording and formed the combined preparation plan.

independent_review.scope: A distinct luna_worker reviewer raised XQ-R01/R02, the original producer remediated them, and the same reviewer independently rechecked and closed both findings with ended sessions and released claims.

final_delivery.scope: After recheck, the original coordinator produced the final preparation delivery. Root and a distinct read-only reviewer verified the sealed final turn and its scope; onsite readiness, execution and release remain outside this gate.

traceable_receipt.scope: Twelve standard phase seals/extracts, the custom peer publication, 258 final receipt files, 359 fixed review inputs, retained prior/review files and all known failures remain hash-bound. Raw events and native transcripts are excluded from public copying.

fixture_isolation.scope: The run retains its independent fixture namespace and seed project. The final source/artifact snapshots are tied to this project, while the untouched run.json remains a historical preparation receipt and is not treated as proof of later execution.

independent_commit_and_remote_sha.scope: No immutable public artifact commit or verified remote SHA exists yet. Business project HEAD 8f4031f... is the setup commit and does not include uncommitted delivery artifacts; publication must be verified after packaging.

limitations: This plan does not run the packager or create a public commit.
Passed gates are limited to the cited local business evidence and do not infer onsite execution or release.
Native private context, raw events and AWR database files remain excluded.
